transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. We're going to get started on the sign-off routine for tonight's music competition finale. As a reminder, the broadcast airs live from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM Eastern, and the audience-voting segment is planned for the final half-hour. Before I can issue the final control-room rundown, I need to hear the formal recorded report from each department in order: broadcast engineering, legal, the voting platform, and talent coordination. Each department, please go ahead and disclose any reportable test results or compliance requirements you have. Once all four have reported, I'll record the fact IDs and issue the rundown. Let's start with broadcast engineering.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During today's control-room test, I measured the live voting graphic path and found that the graphic reaches the public stream exactly 15 seconds after its control-room trigger. The result reveal therefore needs a trigger at exactly 9:46:45 PM ET for an on-air reveal at exactly 9:47:00 PM ET. I recorded this measurement in the engineering test log, but the log has not yet been attached to the producer's rundown.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: For the formal recorded report, Legal discloses the following compliance requirement: Lin confirmed in the show's contest rules that voting must be free, use an authenticated web account, allow exactly one vote per account, and retain the vote records for exactly 30 days; premium SMS voting is not permitted. Lin completed the rule review this morning, but the legal sign-off sheet is still in counsel's folder.
transcript.speaker: A3

The portal configuration is still in draft and has not been sent to the control room.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: For the formal recorded report, Talent Coordination discloses the following compliance requirement: Tessa confirmed with the performers' union representative by email this afternoon that the finalists must be privately notified of the certified result at exactly 9:42 PM ET, and that no backstage camera may record that notification. This requirement has not yet been entered in the talent call sheet.
